entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can't believe I actually hit one of[n]my friends...
It looked like it hurt.
That was the right move.[clr 27]
You really smacked her.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Did it?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: All I really wanted to do was[n]wake her up to reality.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Really? I hope so...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I honestly didn't expect to connect[n]so well...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But I needed a way to wake her up[n]to the reality of the situation.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know, I have a bad habit of[n]acting in the moment. I can't help[n]but get swept up in emotion...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's why I always have to take[n]extra care to keep myself composed.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My father was the same way...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's not the proper way to act[n]though. There's no telling what would[n]have happened if you hadn't stepped in.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That aside, this place is... interesting.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How did you ever find somewhere[n]like this? You know so much.
I'm a regular here.[clr 27]
It's a popular meeting spot.
Not as much as you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So you come often?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's hard to believe you're really a[n]high schooler. You have so much[n]more life experience than me...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is it really?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I imagine you've encountered[n]a great many people here then.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Some of those people probably lead[n]lives I could never even dream of...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I appreciate the compliment,[n]but I doubt that's true...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Honestly, spending time with you and[n]getting to know Eiko has given me a[n]great deal to think about.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's so much you can miss[n]by living with your head buried[n]between the pages of a book...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I thought I knew how the world worked...[n]but the more I spent time with you guys,[n]the more I realized how naïve I was.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I see now that there are some things[n]I need other people to teach me.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Do you remember how Eiko said I would[n]flunk a test about love? Well, um... I[n]don't know how to study that subject.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...What should I do, [fName]?
I should choose my[n]words carefully...
I should choose my[n]words carefully...
I'm already [clr 2]in a relationship[n]with another girl[clr 27]...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can't learn about romance by myself...
You'll find someone someday.[clr 27]
I'll be your study partner.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: People say those kinds of things[n]are destiny anyway, so I probably[n]shouldn't worry myself over it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And besides, I should at least try[n]to focus on my schoolwork right now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's work hard to achieve our[n]goals together, [fName].
I can sense a strong bond[n]of friendship from Makoto...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: U-Um, I'm not exactly the most[n]well-versed in these matters,[n]so allow me to confirm this...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you... like me?
I do.[clr 27]
That's not what I meant.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um... You really mean it, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: W-Well then...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If, um... If it's all right with you...[n]let's start dating, for real.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This is so embarrassing...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I look forward to, um, growing[n]our relationship, um... together.
I'm now in a relationship[n]with Makoto...
There's no turning back now...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: R-Right, sorry for jumping[n]to conclusions there...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I guess Eiko was right... I really[n]don't know anything about love...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, um... sorry! I don't want[n]things to be awkward between us!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I, just... I'm fine, honestly. [n]Besides, I should at least try to[n]focus on my schoolwork right now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's work hard to achieve our[n]goals together, [fName].
I can sense a strong bond[n]of friendship from Makoto...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: You kids done with your[n]little heart-to-heart yet?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: S-Sorry about that. It's rude[n]of us to stay here so long[n]after only ordering tea...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Oh, don't worry. Just a glimpse[n]into this fresh drama of yours[n]is the only apology I need.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: It's like a nice spritz of lemon[n]in the air. Makes me think back[n]to when I was just a wee girl...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: R-Right. Well, we should be going...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank you again for today.[n]I'll see you later...
